name: prompts-graph
description: A GitHub-style graph of the prompts you send Claude Code: one square per day, shaded by how many you sent.

autoOpen.title: Open automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the graph when a session starts, and again after /clear. Off, it opens only through /prompts-graph.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: The colors the graph is drawn in: clay (Claude Clay) or green (GitHub Green).

transcriptsDir.title: Transcripts folder
transcriptsDir.description: Where Claude Code keeps its session transcripts.
